about: Controlled vocabulary for figure cards' `taxonomy` (and the draft analysis' own `taxonomy`). A run retrieves references two ways: by content (the scout's search) and by method — same paradigm, family, architecture or training — from kb/index.json (`kb match`). Values outside these lists are an error; use 'other' plus a note, and extend the list when a value recurs (user request 2026-11-15: references found by topic alone often draw a different architecture).

family.contrastive-vlp: image-text (or other paired-modality) contrastive pretraining: CLIP, ALIGN, MedCLIP, MGCA
family.fusion-vlp: vision-language pretraining with a fusion encoder / multiple objectives: ALBEF, BLIP, ViLT, CoCa
family.multimodal-llm: a vision (or audio, video) encoder bridged into an LLM: BLIP-2, Flamingo, LLaVA, Qwen-VL
family.vla-robot-policy: vision-language-action and generalist robot policies: RT-2, OpenVLA, Octo, pi0
family.promptable-segmentation: segment-anything style promptable or universal segmentation: SAM, MedSAM, UniverSeg
family.detection-transformer: query-based detection / segmentation transformers: DETR, Deformable DETR, Mask2Former, Grounding DINO
family.open-vocabulary-detection: detection or grounding with text queries: GLIP, OWL-ViT
family.image-backbone: general vision backbones: ViT, Swin, ConvNeXt, DeiT, token merging
family.dense-prediction: segmentation / depth decoders on a backbone: DPT, MaskFormer
family.medical-segmentation: medical image segmentation networks: U-Net variants, UNETR, TransUNet, Swin-Unet
family.self-supervised-vision: joint-embedding self-supervision: SimCLR, MoCo, BYOL, DINO, SwAV, I-JEPA
family.masked-modeling: masked prediction / autoencoding pretraining in any modality: MAE, BEiT, VideoMAE, data2vec, Point-MAE, GraphMAE
family.diffusion-generation: diffusion or score-based generators: DDPM, LDM, DiT, U-ViT, Wuerstchen
family.controllable-generation: conditioning or adapting a pretrained generator: ControlNet, T2I-Adapter, IP-Adapter, GLIGEN, DreamBooth
family.video-generation: text/image-to-video generation: Make-A-Video, Video LDM, AnimateDiff, Tune-A-Video
family.autoregressive-generation: token-based image / audio generators: VQGAN, Muse, VQ-Diffusion
family.gan-translation: GANs and image-to-image translation: CycleGAN, pix2pix
family.neural-rendering: radiance fields and implicit surfaces: NeRF, Mip-NeRF, NeuS, IBRNet, pixelNeRF, LRM
family.gaussian-splatting: 3D Gaussian splatting and its generalisations: 3DGS, pixelSplat
family.point-cloud-learning: point-set networks: PointNet++, DGCNN, Point Transformer, PCT, PointMLP
family.speech-ssl: self-supervised speech representation: wav2vec 2.0, HuBERT, WavLM, BEST-RQ
family.llm-architecture: language-model architecture: Transformer, Mamba, MoE, Switch, DeepSeekMoE
family.llm-alignment: aligning LLMs: RLHF / InstructGPT, DPO, RRHF, Self-Instruct, Llama-2 chat
family.llm-efficiency: LLM inference / compression: quantization, pruning, KV cache, speculative decoding, FlashAttention
family.retrieval-augmented: retrieval-augmented language models and retrievers: RAG, REALM, RETRO, kNN-LM, ColBERT, Self-RAG
family.llm-agent: a single LLM agent acting in a loop: ReAct, Reflexion, Toolformer, Voyager, SWE-agent, Self-Refine, Tree of Thoughts
family.multi-agent: several LLM agents interacting: AutoGen, CAMEL, MetaGPT, Generative Agents
family.reinforcement-learning: online / model-free RL and planning: DQN, PPO, MuZero, RMA
family.world-model: learned world models for RL: Dreamer, IRIS, TWM, STORM
family.offline-rl-sequence: RL as sequence modelling or generative planning: Decision Transformer, Trajectory Transformer, Decision Diffuser, Q-Transformer
family.graph-neural-network: message passing and graph transformers: GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE, PNA, Graphormer, HGT, EGNN
family.recommender: recommendation models: DIN, DCN, xDeepFM, LightGCN, BERT4Rec, P5, TIGER
family.time-series: forecasting / anomaly detection models: Informer, Autoformer, PatchTST, iTransformer, TimesFM, Chronos
family.ai4science-molecule: molecules and materials: EDM, GeoDiff, DiffDock, CDVAE
family.protein-structure: protein structure / design models: AlphaFold, RoseTTAFold, ESMFold, ProteinMPNN, FrameDiff
family.pde-weather: neural operators and weather models: FNO, GraphCast, Pangu-Weather, ClimaX, Transolver
family.inverse-problem-reconstruction: model-based / unrolled reconstruction (MRI, CT, compressed sensing): VarNet, MoDL, ISTA-Net, score-based MRI
family.image-restoration: restoration networks: SwinIR, Restormer, MPRNet, NAFNet, Uformer, PromptIR
family.federated-learning: federated optimisation and personalisation: FedAvg, SCAFFOLD, FedNova, MOON, FedProto
family.driving-perception: multi-camera / lidar perception for driving: BEVFormer, Lift-Splat-Shoot, PointPillars, CenterPoint, SurroundOcc
family.driving-planning: motion forecasting and end-to-end driving: VectorNet, MTR, UniAD, VAD
family.other: none of the above — say what in `note`

architecture.two-tower: two separate encoders (one per modality or view) whose outputs are compared
architecture.single-stream-fusion: one encoder over the concatenated modalities
architecture.fusion-encoder: separate encoders followed by a cross-attention fusion encoder
architecture.bridge-to-llm: a frozen or tuned encoder connected to an LLM through a projector / query transformer
architecture.encoder-decoder: an encoder then a decoder (seq2seq, autoencoder, MAE)
architecture.u-shape: encoder-decoder with skips at each scale
architecture.siamese: two weight-shared branches on two views
architecture.teacher-student: a teacher (often EMA / frozen) supervising a student
architecture.multi-stream: several streams or branches trained side by side (alternating or summed)
architecture.multi-stage: a cascade of stages run one after another (coarse-to-fine, stage 1 / stage 2)
architecture.unrolled-iterative: an optimisation or refinement unrolled into repeated blocks
architecture.recurrent: a recurrent / state-space / looping computation over time
architecture.hierarchical: a feature pyramid or multi-scale hierarchy
architecture.transformer-stack: a plain stack of transformer blocks is the core
architecture.retrieval-augmented: an external store or retriever feeds the model
architecture.memory-bank: a memory / queue / prototype bank read and written over time
architecture.plug-in-module: the contribution is a module inserted into an existing network
architecture.adapter-conditioning: a side network or adapter conditions a frozen backbone
architecture.prompt-conditioned: behaviour is selected by prompts (text, points, boxes, tasks)
architecture.tokenizer-latent: data is mapped to discrete tokens or a latent space first
architecture.implicit-field: a coordinate network / radiance field queried at points
architecture.rendering-pipeline: a differentiable rendering or projection step
architecture.dual-domain: computation alternates between two domains (k-space and image, frequency and time)
architecture.agent-loop: an agent acts, observes and updates in a loop with an environment
architecture.tree-search: search over a tree of states or thoughts
architecture.client-server: clients and a server exchange models or updates (federated)
architecture.other: none of the above — say what in `note`

training.contrastive-1to1: contrastive with one positive per item (CLIP, SimCLR)
training.contrastive-multi-positive: contrastive with several positives (labels, concepts, prototypes, same class)
training.self-distillation: match an EMA / momentum copy of itself
training.reconstruction: reconstruct the input or a target signal
training.rl-offline: offline RL / imitation from logged data
training.preference-optimization: learning from human or AI preferences
training.training-free: no training: inference-time method or prompting
training.other: none of the above — say what in `note`

depicts.real-photos: real images / scans / frames of the data
depicts.data-thumbnails: schematic stand-ins for data (waveforms, point clouds, maps)
depicts.quoted-text: real example sentences, prompts or dialogue
depicts.plots: curves or bar charts inside the figure

about_paradigms: Canonical spellings for taxonomy.paradigm (multi-word names hyphenated). A paradigm not listed may be used with its common name; `kb gaps` lists new ones so they can be added here.
